There is one authored choice defect: q-24499 offers both cos(6π/5), option 1, and cos(4π/5), option 4. These are equal since cos(2π−θ)=cos(θ), so both satisfy the question. The worked solution explicitly states option 1's form; no grade for option 4 is supplied. Independently: q-10835 has derivative 4x+8, so its tangent is y−24=16(x−2). q-24499, q-120348, q-120362, and q-24341 follow from cos²θ−sin²θ=1−2sin²θ=cos(2θ), retaining any prefactor. q-24514 evaluates cos(π/6), and q-7473 evaluates cos(45°). q-69542 and q-7809 have dimensions 4×2 and 1×4. In q-125549 only P and R have two rows and two columns; in q-69517 only G has three rows and one column. The q-139689 diagram gives a=1, b=1, c=0. Linearity gives q-74762 as (−12,16)/4=(−3,4), q-74775 as ((13,5)−7(1,−1))/3=(2,4), and q-74781 as 2(21,17,−14)=(42,34,−28). In q-12008, T is multiplication by the matrix with rows (1,1) and (4,3), so homogeneity, additivity, and linearity all hold. All MA evidence below is quoted verbatim from the owning question's solution.",
